audit_metadata.phase_assessed: Phase 5: Sovereign AI Integration, Unified Whisper Dual-Head Pipeline, Audio Opus Normalizer, Conformal Calibration Engine, Guided SLM Decoding & Open-Source Asset Registry

nfr_1_1_data_sovereignty.verification: 100% of AI inference executes locally within sovereign UAE compute (faster-whisper INT8, WhisperDeepfakeMLPHead, local SLM via Outlines/vLLM); zero external commercial AI calls; Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud API configured with UAE Local Storage enabled for data residency

fr_3_3_webhook_latency_sla.verification: FastAPI gateway acknowledges incoming webhooks in < 50ms with HTTP 200 via Celery high_priority_triage queue decoupling; media processing offloaded asynchronously to dedicated Celery worker pool

fr_4_1_class_a_vs_class_b_segregation.verification: Class A indicators (spoofed URLs, foreign attacker numbers) persisted indefinitely; citizen phone numbers pseudonymized via keyed HMAC-SHA256 with 32-byte salt; raw phone held ephemerally in Redis with 60s TTL and purged from RAM scope post-dispatch

fr_1_1_unified_whisper_dual_head.verification: Single forward pass Whisper feature encoder extracts T x 768 hidden acoustic representations feeding both Whisper ASR text decoder and WhisperDeepfakeMLPHead spoof detector, eliminating redundant neural passes, saving ~3.5GB VRAM and ~180ms latency

fr_1_3_audio_opus_normalization.verification: AudioPreprocessor transcodes multi-format WhatsApp payloads (.ogg Opus, .m4a, .mp4, .wav) to standardized 16kHz mono 16-bit PCM (s16le); simulate_whatsapp_opus_compression validates codec robustness at 16kbps

fr_1_4_nfr_3_1_conformal_calibration.verification: Non-parametric empirical p-value calculation calibrated on n >= 3,000 genuine UAE voice notes mathematically bounds False Positive Rate <= 0.1% at 95% statistical confidence; tri-band routing enforces Red (>0.85), Green (<=0.35), and Amber abstention

fr_1_5_audio_payload_duration_cap.verification: Strict 120.0s duration ceiling enforced across all ingress audio codecs; payloads > 120s raise AudioDurationExceededError immediately, preventing GPU queue starvation

fr_2_4_nfr_1_3_slm_guided_decoding_and_p.verification: Outlines FSM JSON logit masking and vLLM structured schemas strictly enforce TextTriageInferenceResult; citizen text bounded inside XML tags (<citizen_forwarded_text>); deterministic triage hierarchy prevents SLM from overriding allowlist Green verdicts

protocol_rule_11_air_gapped_zero_saas.verification: 11 upstream open-source repositories, 5 evaluation benchmark datasets, and model profiles stored locally in c:/HARES/opensource/; zero runtime WAN dependencies for offline sovereign execution

new_phase5_observations.title: Case-Insensitive XML Boundary Tag Escaping in SLM Ingress
new_phase5_observations.description: LocalSLMClient.triage_text strips closing tags using sanitized_text.replace('</citizen_forwarded_text>', ''). Because string replacement is case-sensitive, an adversarial payload employing case variations (e.g. </Citizen_forwarded_text> or </CITIZEN_FORWARDED_TEXT>) would bypass stripping and simulate boundary termination prior to model tokenization.
new_phase5_observations.recommendation: Use case-insensitive regex substitution: re.sub(r'</citizen_forwarded_text>', '', sanitized_text, flags=re.IGNORECASE) to eliminate case-variation circumvention.

new_phase5_observations.title: PyTorch Model Weight Checkpoint Deserialization Safety (weights_only=True)
new_phase5_observations.description: UnifiedAudioTriage._load_head_weights executes torch.load(weights_path, map_location='cpu') without explicit weights_only=True. In enterprise deployments where checkpoint files might be updated or mounted from network volumes, unconstrained torch.load allows arbitrary Python object deserialization.
new_phase5_observations.recommendation: Explicitly pass weights_only=True: torch.load(weights_path, map_location='cpu', weights_only=True) to guarantee pure tensor state dictionary deserialization.

new_phase5_observations.title: Subprocess Environment Variable Scrubbing for FFmpeg Workers
new_phase5_observations.description: AudioPreprocessor._transcode_via_ffmpeg and simulate_whatsapp_opus_compression invoke subprocess.Popen without an explicit env parameter, inheriting the complete worker process environment (including database credentials and API secrets).
new_phase5_observations.recommendation: Pass an explicit sanitized environment dictionary: env={'PATH': os.environ.get('PATH', ''), 'SYSTEMROOT': os.environ.get('SYSTEMROOT', '')} to isolate child media conversion processes.

new_phase5_observations.title: Finite-Value & Range Validation on Ingested Conformal Calibration Arrays
new_phase5_observations.description: ConformalCalibrator.load_calibration_scores sorts raw floats without validating finiteness. Corrupted telemetry samples containing NaN or Inf could distort quantile calculations and non-parametric bounds.
new_phase5_observations.recommendation: Filter calibration scores to enforce math.isfinite(s) and 0.0 <= s <= 1.0 before quantile sorting.
